title: Ya Seen: A Warning and Messengers to a Town

paragraphs.text: The Prophet is truly one of the messengers, on a straight path. The Qur'an is sent down by the Mighty, the Merciful, so that he may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned and who are unaware. The word has come true for most of them, so they do not believe. It is as if chains were placed around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced up. A barrier is in front of them and behind them, and they are covered, so they cannot see. Whether they are warned or not, they will not believe. A warning only helps the one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful without seeing Him. Such a person should be given good news of forgiveness and a noble reward. Allah gives life to the dead and records everything people do and leave behind, which He has counted in a clear register.

The Prophet is told to give the example of a town to which messengers came. Allah sent two, and when the people denied them, He made them stronger with a third. The messengers said that they were sent to them. The people replied that they were only humans like them and were lying. The messengers answered that their Lord knows they are truthful, and that their only duty was to deliver the message clearly. The people said that the messengers brought bad luck, and they threatened to stone them if they did not stop. The messengers replied that their bad luck was with themselves, because they were a people who crossed limits. Then a man came running from the far end of the town and told his people to follow the messengers.
